resources.string: App background rules and one-key cleanup
Choose how apps run in the background. Memory Boost cleans eligible cached processes and keeps resident, foreground and important apps running.
Block automatic process starts. Opening the app still works.
Clean background processes after they are no longer important. This can delay notifications.
Clean eligible processes when you remove the app from Recents.
Protect from cleanup and give running processes higher memory priority. Android can still reclaim them under pressure.
Protected system role or shared UID
No eligible background processes to clean
